build_PCPVT_backbone: build a Twins-PCPVT vision transformer backbone with configurable embed_dims, num_heads, and sr_ratios for semantic segmentation
build_SVT_backbone: build a Twins-SVT backbone that alternates LSA and GSA encoder layers with configurable window sizes
review_GSAEncoderLayer: review the GSAEncoderLayer class that combines Global Subsampled Attention with feed-forward networks and DropPath
review_LocallyGroupedSelfAttention: review the LocallyGroupedSelfAttention module that computes windowed self-attention with padding and attention masking
review_ConditionalPositionEncoding: review the ConditionalPositionEncoding module that applies depthwise convolutions to tokens for positional encoding
